ingredients.title: Sauté
items: 1 Tbsp olive oil
1 yellow onion, diced
1 lb mild Italian sausage, ground
1-2 cloves garlic, minced

ingredients.title: Pressure cook
items: 1 box noodles (elbows or shells work well)
1-3 cups water (enough to just barely cover the noodles)
1 jar pasta sauce
1 Tbsp Italian seasoning

ingredients.title: To finish
items: 1-2 cups heavy cream
Parmesan cheese, as a topping

instructions.title: Sauté
items: Set instant pot to sauté and add olive oil
Add diced onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes (can sauté at the same time as browning the sausage)
Add ground sausage and cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon
Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds
Add 1 cup water and scrape the bottom of the pot to deglaze

instructions.title: Pressure cook
items: Add noodles. Add more water if needed to just barely cover the noodles
Add pasta sauce and Italian seasoning. Do not stir! Let the pasta sauce sit on top of the noodles
Pressure cook on high for half the cook time recommended on the noodle box (usually 3 minutes)
Quick release pressure after time is up

instructions.title: To finish
items: Stir in heavy cream and top with Parmesan cheese
